about.title: A React starter built with TanStack Start
about.content: Build your next React application with TanStack Start, type-safe routing, and TanStack Query for data fetching. This starter includes Better Auth sign-in connected to the Hono API, reusable UI components, English and Vietnamese localization with Paraglide, and Sentry monitoring, so you can focus on building your product.
